title: BrowserPageCapture v0.1
description: Producer-owned schema for the BrowserPageCapture observation artifact. Describes the exact output of normalizeCaptureData() in src/lib/browserPageCapture.ts. This is NOT an HTTP response capture and NOT truth evidence.

requested_url.description: URL reported by Chrome for the tab at capture time. Empty string if absent after normalization.

current_url.description: document.URL at the moment of capture. Empty string if absent after normalization.

canonical_url.description: <link rel='canonical'> href, or null if absent or empty after normalization.

document_title.description: Page title. Empty string if absent after normalization.

document_language.description: html[lang] value (BCP 47, max 35 chars), or null if absent.

meta_description.description: <meta name='description'> content, or null if absent.

json_ld.description: Parsed JSON-LD objects from <script type='application/ld+json'> blocks. Each item is the result of JSON.parse on a bounded raw block. Array is always present; may be empty.

selected_text.description: window.getSelection() text if any was selected at capture time, or null.

main_text.description: innerText of the first <main> or <article> element (forms stripped), or null.

rendered_text.description: document.body innerText with form/script/style nodes stripped, or null.

captured_at.description: Timestamp supplied by the capture boundary (background service worker). Intended to be ISO 8601 but the producer passes it through unchanged — no format constraint is enforced.
